tasks.subject: Help with a birthday present!
tasks.text: …Thanks for the photos! My mum's birthday is next month and I want to give her something special, but I have no idea what. What presents do you usually give to your family, and why? Do you prefer buying gifts or making them yourself? How do you celebrate birthdays in your family? By the way, I've just got a puppy…

questions: How often do you walk him?
Does he sleep in your room?
